description: Implementation of the MediaPipelineService class, which manages media pipeline sessions, including creation, destruction, media loading, source attachment, playback controls, and capability queries within a media server context.

classes.name: MediaPipelineService
classes.description: A service class managing media pipeline sessions, including creation, control, and querying of media pipelines within a media server environment.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::MediaPipelineService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the media pipeline service with dependencies and creating media pipeline capabilities.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::~MediaPipelineService
methods.description: Destructor with debug logging.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::clearMediaPipelines
methods.description: Clears all active media pipelines.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::createSession
methods.description: Creates a new media pipeline session if conditions permit.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::destroySession
methods.description: Destroys an existing media pipeline session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::load
methods.description: Loads media into a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached for a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::play
methods.description: Starts playback for a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::pause
methods.description: Pauses playback for a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::stop
methods.description: Stops playback for a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::setPosition
methods.description: Sets the playback position for a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video window position and size.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::haveData
methods.description: Indicates new data availability for a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::renderFrame
methods.description: Requests rendering of a frame.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::getVolume
methods.description: Gets the current volume for a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::setMute
methods.description: Sets mute state for a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::getMute
methods.description: Gets mute state for a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves supported MIME types for a media source type.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService::isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a MIME type is supported.
